profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Dependable and self-motivated with more than 20 years of experience in IT/Computer Technology field. Experience in different industries such as Manufacturing, Retail, Security Monitoring, Travel, Tax & Accounting.

Looking to add value to the organization by executing the organization’s goals and objectives based on the execution of major projects and Digital Transformation initiatives.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
positions.description: Develop inventory control applications and solutions (internal and external) to empower our retail customers to control their inventory counting process.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Lead)
positions.description: Leading the implementation of new technologies to change the way our corporate customers manage travel. Implementing new processes and policies to support agile (scrum) methodologies.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on software Applications/Solutions that simplifies the lives of tax and accounting professionals. Using my skills to add value to company's vision for its Digital Transformation spearhead initiative and the next generation of SaaS Applications.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Support new development and enhancements for one of the leading commercial and residential monitoring system (Central Station Software).

positions.title: Network Manager
positions.description: Managed IT infrastructure and ERP manufacturing system for a national leader in the Composite Manufacturing Industry.

positions.title: Network Support Engineer MTS I
positions.description:
Managed IT infrastructure for Organization involved in the Defense/Aerospace Industry.

Maintained and supported various Engineering Application tools throughout the company.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help make the Association one of the best in North Texas.
